controls._comment: PMDG 777 writes use the shared adapter and official SDK routes only. Generic AP, gear/flap key-event, and LVar write fallbacks are intentionally absent.

meta.notes: PMDG 777 family profile using the official 777 SDK and guarded backend-owned event routes. SDK data requires EnableDataBroadcast=1; writes require matching live ClientData and the SDK event writer.

sources.name: PMDG 777 MSFS SDK manual and installed sample
sources.notes: The installed PMDG 777-300ER 2.4.141 SDK manual, header, and connection sample define the 684-byte read-only ClientData contract, direct-position control events and data-broadcast requirement. The audited header SHA-256 is 3D0ECFB39FE7524A5017B63C7CB52F4D850B97F738ED5D4D8F1637AFC1A676F7. Flight Fabric's checked-in pmdg-777x-clientdata connector is loaded through the declarative clientdata-manifest adapter; the public source includes Flight Fabric's independently written SDK interoperability mappings but not PMDG headers, manuals, samples, binaries, or other vendor files. APU START interaction reviewed 2026-09-10 after the related 737 report, installed PMDG 777-300ER 2.4.146: 77W_Cockpit_Behavior.xml component switch_03_a defines control 3 with clockwise/right press action 2 and release action 4. START sends ROTOR_BRAKE 302, 302, 304 to rotate through ON into START and release once. This replaces the unverified direct SDK event 69635 payload 2; ELEC_APU_Selector OFF=0, ON=1, START=2 describes telemetry. The sequence retains matching SDK connectivity, exact-profile routing, cooldown and no retry, and acknowledges only after all three interactions are accepted. APURunning remains independent observation and suppresses a new START when fresh. No spool-up delay is added. A live 777 failure has not been confirmed; live retesting is pending. See docs/APU-START-VALIDATION.md. ATC/EFIS review 2026-09-07: installed SDK/header and cockpit XML define EFIS_RangeSel, EFIS_MinsSelBARO and the IDENT mouse interaction through ROTOR_BRAKE (press switch*100+1, release switch*100+4). 777 switch 746, EFIS_BaroMinimumsSet at 513/514, signed EFIS_BaroMinimums at 516/520, EFIS_RadioMinimumsSet at 524/525 and signed EFIS_RadioMinimums at 528/532 in the 684-byte native layout. Approach-control review 2026-09-07 against installed PMDG_777X_SDK.h (2.4.146): DOWN/UP/50PCT speedbrake targets use events 74613/74615/74616, one left press/release and existing FCTL_Speedbrake_Lever confirmation at 0/100/50. Existing arming, flap and autobrake detents are preserved. See docs/APPROACH-CONTROLS-AIRCRAFT-COVERAGE.md; live validation is pending.

knownIssues: The 777-300ER is the first live-validation target; the 200ER, 200LR, and 777F variants require in-aircraft testing.
The expanded control catalog is structurally checked against the installed SDK but remains unverified until each switch is confirmed in the simulator.
Guarded emergency, maintenance, door, and momentary controls remain intentionally unavailable.

Start APU UI and voice preset is source-backed and covered by automated transport tests; live start, electrical prerequisites, selector release and aircraft variant/build coverage remain untested. See docs/APU-START-VALIDATION.md.
